name: Buick V8 (Nailhead 364 / 401 / 425, 400 / 430 / 455)
description: The Buick V8s: the Nailhead (364, 401, 425) with its 1958 Special, Century and Roadmaster builds, the Wildcat 445 and 465 and the dual-quad Super Wildcat, and the big block (400, 430, 455) with the GS 400, the Wildcat, the GS 455 and its Stage 1, the Riviera and a Stage 1 crate engine. Every part ours, drawn from solids; the Super Turbine 400 from Jorma Rysky's "Naturally Aspirated 454 cid V8" (Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0).

builds.engine: Buick 455 Stage 1 crate engine with headers
Buick 425 Nailhead Super Wildcat dual quad 360 hp (1965)
